name: Gekisai Dai Ni
description: The second kata in the Gekisai series, building upon the foundation established by Gekisai Dai Ichi.

origin.title: Origin
origin.content: Developed alongside Gekisai Dai Ichi by Chōjun Miyagi and Shoshin Nagamine around 1940, this kata serves as a progression from the first Gekisai kata.

transmission.title: Transmission to Goju-Ryu
transmission.content: This kata was passed down through the Goju-Ryu lineage.

historicalDevelopment.title: Historical Development and Variations
historicalDevelopment.content: The kata has maintained its core structure while allowing for minor variations between schools.

technicalFeatures.title: Technical and Philosophical Features
technicalFeatures.content: The second kata in the Gekisai series, building upon the foundation established by Gekisai Dai Ichi.

controversy.title: Controversy/Variations within Goju-Ryu
controversy.content: There are minor variations in timing and emphasis between different Goju-Ryu schools.

relationships.title: Relationship to other kata/Systems
relationships.content: This kata is part of the Goju-Ryu curriculum.

modernPractice.title: Use in Modern Practice
modernPractice.content: This kata is used to develop techniques and understanding in Goju-Ryu training.

nameAndMeaning.title: Nome e Significato
nameAndMeaning.content: Il nome e il significato di questo kata riflettono le sue origini e scopo tradizionali.
